<profile>
Sells: Lumière Living sells home goods under its own Lumière brand. The catalogue includes soft furnishings such as a throw and a cushion, decorative pieces such as a vase and a diffuser, and table linen in the form of linen napkins sold as a set of four in Oat, Sage and Charcoal.
Audience: The products suit people furnishing and decorating their homes, including those looking for soft furnishings, decor and table linen.
Country: US
Tone: friendly
Never say: —
</profile>

<products>
<group name="Table linen">
  P1: Linen Napkins, set of 4
    - The Linen Napkins come as a set of 4.
    - The Linen Napkins are table linen.
    - The Linen Napkins are made by Lumière.
    - The Linen Napkins are available in the colours Oat, Sage and Charcoal.
    - The Linen Napkins are made of 100% European flax linen.
    - The Linen Napkins are stonewashed.
    - Each Linen Napkin measures 45 × 45 cm.
    - The Linen Napkins can be machine washed at 40 °C.
    - The Linen Napkins set contains four napkins in one colour.
</group>
</products>
